text:
Lina: tiny break — Marshmallow (my sugar glider) made an unplanned cameo in my 1:1 and executed a flawless slow-mo gliding entrance. clip: marshmallow_slowmo.mp4 https://i.imgur.com/marsh123.mp4 :glider:
Ben: no way. slow-mo glider is my new startup idea. entrepreneurial energy: off the charts :rocket:
Izzy: drop the clip pls, i need this for morale research :eyes:
Lina: uploading... `marshmallow_slowmo.mp4` — https://i.imgur.com/marsh123.mp4
Claire: that tiny landing. the little paw tuck at 0:07 killed me :sob: :heart:
Ben: contextual question: is there a sugar-glider-friendly snack i can bring if we do an office cameo?
Lina: fruit bits or mealworms (tiny ones). bribery is effective. also keep cat dogs away — Marshmallow has opinions about pets.
dev-bot: note: office-guest policy reminder sent to #people-ops (automated)
sticker-bot: :sugar_glider: sticker added
Izzy: poll: should we have a 10-minute "Pet Cameo" slot at next Friday's town hall? react :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no
Ben: +1 for yes. i will prepare applause track.
Claire: +1 but only if Marshmallow promises not to steal the slides.
Lina: guarantee: Marshmallow will only rearrange my pen cup.
Izzy: follow-up: anyone want to volunteer to take a 5-sec slow-mo trial clip of their pet for the highlight reel?
Ben: i'll submit my dog Rue's zoom-snooze clip. low effort, high yawn content.
Claire: also, tiny merch idea: "Marshmallow Approved" enamel pins. proceeds to local animal shelter?
Lina: love that. i'll sketch a concept: tiny glider silhouette mid-glide.
Izzy: conclusion: morale boosted, meeting salvaged, Marshmallow promoted to "Chief Airborne Officer" :trophy: @everyone
Ben: nominate for employee of the week.
Lina: will accept tiny treats and one shoebox throne. end of thread.
